description: First call for structured or hybrid requests. Returns READY source snapshot, period coverage, timezone, fictional rule version and INR assumption. No READY row means setup is not ready.
Portfolio metrics at month grain. Reports rule flags, gross exposure and P1 account count; no balances, revenue, confirmed fraud or model probability. Resolves period 0 to latest observed.
query: SELECT * FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.portfolio_monthly_sql WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.snapshot_metadata_sql WHERE status = 'READY') AND period_key = CASE WHEN CAST({{period_key}} AS INT) = 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(period_key) FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.portfolio_monthly_sql WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.snapshot_metadata_sql WHERE status = 'READY')) ELSE CAST({{period_key}} AS INT) END LIMIT 1

description: Latest twelve observed monthly portfolio rows ending in the requested month. Gaps remain missing; do not interpret prior observed row as prior calendar month or sum active_accounts across months.

description: Top ten flagged account-months ranked by flagged gross, retaining P1/P2 rule priority and total candidate count. Order is exposure rank, not proof of fraud or predicted loss. Empty results mean no flags, not confirmed safety.
query: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_candidate_accounts FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.account_risk_monthly_sql WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.snapshot_metadata_sql WHERE status = 'READY') AND period_key = CASE WHEN CAST({{period_key}} AS INT) = 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(period_key) FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.portfolio_monthly_sql WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM finance.agent_demo_fs.snapshot_metadata_sql WHERE status = 'READY')) ELSE CAST({{period_key}} AS INT) END AND flagged_count > 0 ORDER BY flagged_gross_inr DESC, flagged_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
